title: Uruguayan Red Onion Bhaji
description: Crispy onion fritters inspired by Uruguayan flavors, with a hint of jubilant spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
Slice the red onion into thin rings.
In a bowl, mix together the sliced onions, Uruguayan, jubilant, and a pinch of salt.
Dip each onion ring into the bowl of spice mixture, coating evenly.
Carefully place the coated onion rings into the hot oil.
Fry for 3-4 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
